# Sounds

Twelve tokens on one material: nine sounds and three for AI feedback.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/SoundSounds.mdx`

## Material

Every sound is struck on one material, Detent: a dry abacus bead, a short tick, then a soft knock. Before it lands it clicks three notches, the pickup, which takes . A token sets its notes and its level, nothing else.

## Key

Every sound is in C major, tuned to whole-number ratios on . Milestone is tuned a fourth lower, on . Any two sounds can play back to back without clashing.

## The sound sheet

Length runs from the first notch to the last note falling silent. Tokens drop their `sound.` prefix elsewhere in the docs.

## Levels

Each token sits on one of three levels, measured offline as its loudest 50 ms.

## AI feedback

An AI sound counts in first: six rising ticks over , then the result.

## In code

```js
import { playSound } from '@/components';

playSound('done.step');
```

`playSound` plays nothing until the first tap or key press on the page, and nothing while the switch is off. Mount `SoundProvider` once at the app root to unlock audio on that first gesture.
